**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is interested in must-try dishes in Bangkok that are not too spicy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended dishes include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Pad Thai - a stir-fried rice noodle dish with vegetables, tofu, egg, and often chicken or shrimp.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Tom Yum Goong - a sour and spicy soup with shrimp, but it can be made mild.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Som Tam - a green papaya salad with peanuts, tomatoes, and lime juice, can be made without chili pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Massaman Curry - a mild curry with potatoes, peanuts, and tender beef or chicken.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Khao Man Gai - boiled chicken served with rice and a side of clear soup, soy sauce, and ginger sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Kuay Teow Nam Tok - noodles in a broth-like sauce made from beef and sweetened by spices.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Stir-fried morning glory - a popular Thai vegetable dish fried with garlic and oyster sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Mango Sticky Rice - a popular dessert made with coconut sticky rice and fresh mango.  

[USER] Asked for recommendations for good vegetarian restaurants in Bangkok.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended vegetarian restaurants include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. May Kaidee's - a popular vegetarian chain with several locations in the city, serving a variety of Thai and international dishes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Broccoli Revolution - a trendy vegetarian cafe offering organic food, juices, and smoothies with an emphasis on fresh vegetables.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Veganerie - a vegan bakery and restaurant that serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner options, with a special afternoon tea set and a wide variety of gluten-free options.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Rasayana Retreat - a raw food restaurant and detox center that offers plant-based, raw food, and cleansing menus along with health-oriented workshops.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Sustaina - a vegan Thai restaurant that serves dishes made from fresh ingredients and offers a range of international flavors.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Ethos Vegetarian and Vegan Cafe - a small casual restaurant with a good selection of plant-based food and fresh juices.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Koko - a vegan restaurant focusing on Japanese cuisine, offering vegan sushi, noodles, and tempuras.
